main_body: three-story brick campus building with flat concrete roof
top_band: light grey tiled flat roof with parapet border and rooftop vents, rows 1-40
evidence: The flat roof top surface occupies rows 1-40 (grey concrete tiles with rooftop vents and a light parapet rim at rows 38-40). Below the parapet is a cream cornice (rows 41-45), a dark eave shadow line (row 46), and the three-story brick front facade with inset windows and double doors (rows 41-143).

style.evidence: The brick facade has rich per-brick shading and mortar variation across 4-5 warm brown tones; the roof slab shows grid lines and speckled concrete texture; windows have multi-step glass reflections and sill shadows; outlines use dark brown/grey material tones rather than flat black.
